## `#BASIC` Element

This is a stub documentation for the `#BASIC` element.

### Usage

```erlang
#BASIC{
    attr1=something,
    attr2="something else"
}
```

### Attributes

- `attr1` (type) - This attribute does something
- `attr2` (type) - This attribute does a different thing
